summary: You can see how far long steps are, and Microsoft's security fixes reach you the same day.

new.title: Long steps show their progress
new.text: Long steps such as comparing vulnerability findings and finishing the configuration items now report how far they are every few minutes. A long night no longer looks stuck to you or to support.

new.title: Microsoft security fixes reach you the same day
new.text: When Microsoft publishes security fixes for the system SecurityInsight runs on, a release with them is tested and rolled out the same day. If it fails, your installation goes back to what it ran before.
